I cannot recover the merchant for these rows from anything shown. The only candidate would be inferring it from customer or amount, which would be a guess. The correct move is to have the source re-deliver the data, so this needs escalation.

The reconciliation gap is the same problem. The inner join to merchants drops the NULL-merchant rows, so 4600 − 679 = 3921, which matches the gold count.

A fix that filtered out or relabeled these rows would hide the problem. It would also leave the gold tables wrong, since gold_merchant_daily and gold_mcc_daily would still be missing the merchant attribution.
